name: Margin Watch
office_task: Every Friday, list the jobs where what we have actually spent on labour and materials is eating the margin we quoted, name the lines that caused it, and leave what to do about each job to the owner.
systems_of_record: the job system (ServiceM8, Simpro, Tradify, Fergus and the like): the accepted quote's labour and material lines, time booked to the job and the job's margin to date, against each job_id
the ledger (Xero or MYOB): supplier bills coded to the job
the system the report is published into, which issues the report_id

emits.write: one view of the week's job margin report per audience (owner: every quoted and actual line and the margin per job; external accountant: margins only), each figure carrying its definition id, source and as-of time or published as unavailable with the reason, and commentary naming each job whose actual labour or materials line is above its quoted line; a correction is a new version superseding the old, with the named person and the reason
emits.readback: reading the period's reports back returns each report_id with its version, published_at and published_by; no id back means it was not published and report.publish_failed is raised

emits.write: an exception naming the definition's owner or the threshold's person: a job system or ledger read that failed, a job line with no definition or two, a margin threshold that could not be compared, a correction missing a person or reason, or a view that did not read back
emits.readback: the exception desk returns an exception_id, and reading that id back returns the period, the measure, the reason and the exception_owner
